/invite.reason: Explains a bearer invitation to a person who has no account yet; it reads no data.

/sign-in.reason: The sign-in page; it only sends someone who is already signed in to the right place.

layout (root).reason: The shell around every page, including sign-in; it shows each person the menu for their level and reads no data.

GET /api/auth/[...route].reason: The sign-in flow with the identity provider; it starts or finishes a sign-in and has no session to check yet.

POST /api/auth/[...route].reason: Sign-out and the other steps of the sign-in flow; they act on the caller's own session cookie.

POST /api/doors/[name]/[kind]/events.reason: Slack and Telegram call this; the platform's own signature is checked before anything is read or changed.

POST /api/private-metadata/credential.reason: Called by a server with a bearer credential, not by a browser; the bearer is checked before anything is read.

POST /v1/gateway-budget/[operation].reason: Called by the model gateway; the signature is checked on the exact request bytes before anything is changed.

getChangesState.GET /api/accounts/google/callback: Finishes connecting a Google account: it stores the new connection.
getChangesState.GET /api/accounts/microsoft/callback: Finishes connecting a Microsoft account: it stores the new connection.
getChangesState.GET /api/auth/[...route]: The callback step creates the signed-in session.

publicByDesign./invite: A person with an invitation link has no account yet.
publicByDesign./sign-in: A signed-out person has to be able to sign in.
